fields.name: collectionIp
fields.docString: The user-provided IP address used to collect for this device. There are some special cases. fields.docString: The approximate time at which collection occured for this device in this snapshot. fields.name: backfillTime
fields.docString: If the data for this device has been backfilled from a previous snapshot, then the approximate time at which that data was collected in that snapshot. Otherwise, this device has not been backfilled and this value is absent. Absent for custom sources.

fields.name: mtu
fields.docString: The max transmission unit size in octets for the physical interface. Note that this is the L2 MTU, which is normalized to include the length of the L2 payload, but not the L2 header and trailers (such as the MAC source and destination, Ethernet type, or VLAN headers). Some vendors include the length of the L2 header when reporting the L2 MTU, and as a result the MTU value reported by the device will differ from the value reported here. For example, Cisco IOS-XR includes L2 headers. An interface that reports a 1514 byte MTU on IOS-XR is normalized to 1500 after subtracting 14 bytes of L2 headers.

fields.docString: A set of location names. The constraint is satisfied for a device when its location is any of the provided names. If empty, the constraint is satisfied for all devices.

fields.name: value
fields.docString: Whether the interface connects to a customer edge device (i.e. is CE-facing).

type.name: StigPolicyCondition
type.docString: The condition (a set of constraints) under which a policy applies to a device in the network. The condition is true for a device when all constraint fields on this set are satisfied.

fields.name: ordinal
fields.docString: The order in which this condition appears in the policy. Policy values are sourced from the first condition whose constraints are satisfied.

fields.name: deviceNamePattern
fields.docString: A regular expression pattern. The constraint is satisfied for a device when the pattern matches its name. If empty, the constraint is satisfied for all devices.

fields.name: ifaceNamePattern
fields.docString: A regular expression pattern. The constraint is satisfied for an interface when the pattern matches its name, or for a device when the pattern matches any interface on the device. If empty, the constraint is satisfied for all interfaces.

fields.name: vrfName
fields.docString: A VRF name. The constraint is satisfied for a VRF when the name matches exactly. If empty, the constraint is satisfied for all VRFs.

fields.name: tagNames
fields.docString: A set of tag names. The constraint is satisfied for a device when it is tagged by any of the provided names. If empty, the constraint is satisfied for all devices.

fields.name: locationNames
fields.docString: A set of location names. The constraint is satisfied for a device when its location is any of the provided names. If empty, the constraint is satisfied for all devices.

fields.name: value
fields.docString: Whether the interface connects to a DODIN backbone device.

fields.name: parameterName
fields.docString: The segmented name of the parameter as it appears in the policy file; for example, "device.allowedServices".

fields.name: rules
fields.docString: The list of vulnerability IDs (e.g. V-123456) of the rules that use the parameter named 'parameterName'.

fields.name: allowedServices
fields.docString: The list of services that are allowed to run on the device.

fields.name: allowedCertificationAuthorityEnrollmentUrls
fields.docString: The list of allowed Certification Authority (CA) enrollment URLs.

fields.name: managementSubnets
fields.docString: The list of subnets in CIDR notation used for management access.

fields.name: isProviderEdge
fields.docString: Whether the device is a provider edge device.

fields.name: allowedBgpPeers
fields.docString: The list of IP addresses or subnets of allowed BGP neighbors. Allowed BGP neighbors must be DOD devices. BGP peering with commercial ISPs is disallowed.

fields.name: requiresDefaultVlan
fields.docString: Whether the interface requires the default VLAN.

fields.name: requiresMulticast
fields.docString: Whether the interface requires multicast routing.

fields.name: isHostGateway
fields.docString: Whether the interface is the gateway for a set of hosts.

fields.name: pseudowireVirtualCircuitId
fields.docString: The virtual circuit ID (VC ID) assigned to the interface.

fields.name: toExternalDevice
fields.docString: Whether the interface connects to the interface of a device that is in another network (a network in a different administrative domain).

fields.name: toAccessLayerSwitch
fields.docString: Whether the interface is connected to an access layer switch.

fields.name: toUntrustedDevice
fields.docString: Whether the interface connects to one or more untrusted devices, such as a user device or an untrusted gateway. Such interfaces should not be in trunk mode.

fields.name: toCoreLayer
fields.docString: Whether the interface is connected to the core layer.

fields.name: viaFiberOptics
fields.docString: Whether the interface connects to its neighbor via fiber optics.

fields.name: toCustomerEdgeDevice
fields.docString: Whether the interface connects to a customer edge device (i.e. is CE-facing).

fields.name: toDodinBackbone
fields.docString: Whether the interface connects to a DODIN backbone device.

fields.name: name
fields.docString: The Forward Networks name of the STIG. For example, "Palo Alto Networks NDM"

fields.name: id
fields.docString: The version identifier, such as "V1R4".

fields.name: id
fields.docString: The ruleId, such as SV-220623r863275_rule.

fields.name: version
fields.docString: Rule version, such as CISC-L2-000020.

fields.name: groupTitle
fields.docString: Group title, such as SRG-NET-000148-L2S-000015

type.name: NetworkExtensions
type.docString: Contains user-defined extensions to the standard Network data model. By default, this type has no fields. In any Forward Instance, this type will have one field for each Data File defined.
